text:
Situation: Lactulose supply is constrained. Corvale General holds 223 units with 24 days on hand at current use. Corvale Lakeside holds 35 units with 19 days on hand. The product on our labels is manufactured by Xttrium Laboratories, Inc. (FEI 3008436464).

Why (FDA record): FDA inspection 1273417 of the Xttrium plant ended on 2025-06-18 and was classified Official Action Indicated (OAI); the classification was known on 2025-09-16. The plant's most recent inspection, FDA inspection 1324176, ended on 2026-06-16 and was classified Voluntary Action Indicated (VAI). Lactulose is not listed on the FDA drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory covers less than one month at both sites. No FDA shortage listing exists to trigger allocation programs. The prior OAI classification and recent VAI classification at the sole labeled manufacturer represent a supply continuity risk.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to evaluate and qualify APOZEAL PHARMACEUTICALS INC as an alternate source; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
2. Buyer to evaluate and qualify Actavis Pharma, Inc. as an alternate source; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
3. Buyer to evaluate and qualify American Health Packaging as an alternate source; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
4. Buyer to evaluate and qualify Atlantic Biologicals Corp. as an alternate source; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
5. Buyer to evaluate and qualify Bajaj Medical, LLC as an alternate source; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.

Not recommended: Waiting for an FDA shortage listing before securing alternate supply.
